log_file.description: Path to the lsyncd log file.

max_processes.description: Maximum number of parallel sync processes. Prevents system overload.

delay.description: Seconds to wait after first change before triggering sync (debounce).

use_inotify_events.description: Override default inotify event set (modify, move, create, delete) with custom list.

inotify_events.description: List of inotify event types to monitor.

excludes.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from sync.

has_rsync_options.description: Customize rsync options for local or remote sync.

rsync_options.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to rsync.

targets.description: List of sync targets. Each defines a source → destination mapping.
